mapper.select: select cxr.TREAD_CODE, /*胎面代码*/ nvl(sum(cxr.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY*cxr.TREAD_SHOULDER_LENGTH/1000),0) CX_CLASS3_PLAN_CONSUME, /*半制品对应成型(8点-16点)计划量的消耗量*/ nvl(sum(cf.FINISH_QTY*cxr.TREAD_SHOULDER_LENGTH/1000), 0) CX_FINISH_CONSUME /*半制品对应成型(8点-12点)完成量的消耗量*/ from ( select r.EMBRYO_CODE, r.BOM_DATA_VERSION, max(ci.TREAD_CODE) TREAD_CODE, /*胎面代码*/ max(ci.TREAD_SHOULDER_LENGTH) TREAD_SHOULDER_LENGTH, /*胎面长*/ sum(r.CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY) CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY /*8点-16点成型计划量*/ from T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT r inner join T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on r.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and r.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION and ci.DEL_FLAG = 0 /*施工信息表*/ where schedule_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') and r.DEL_FLAG = 0 group by r.EMBRYO_CODE,r.BOM_DATA_VERSION ) cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ left join T_CX_PART_FINISH_QTY cf on cf.stat_date = to_date(#{scheduleDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')-1 /*排程日期 要减1天，才是对应8-12点完成量日期*/ and cf.DEL_FLAG = 0 and cf.embryo_code = cxr.embryo_code and cf.BOM_DATA_VERSION = cxr.BOM_DATA_VERSION group by cxr.TREAD_CODE

select MATERIAL_CODE treadCode, (nvl(STOCK_NUM,0)+nvl(MODIFY_NUM,0)-nvl(BAD_NUM,0)) STOCK_NUM from T_TM_STOCK where STOCK_DATE = to_date(#{stockDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') - 1 /*排程日期 要减1天，才是对应库存日期*/ and DEL_FLAG = '0'
